Fri Oct 23, 5:24 AM PDT. You asked whether rescuers and raiders use the same ladder mechanic. I read the code: mostly yes, with three differences. SAME: both use the one carryable ladder (the same building, same art), and nobody can climb the other side's ladder. A raid's ladders are open only to that raid, and your raised ladders lock raiders out (the jail rule). DIFFERENT: (1) Raiders 'bring' theirs: a raider sets a finished ladder after a short timer (about 10 s plus 1 s per metre), with no materials. Colonists either install a spare ladder they already own or build a new one from materials like any construction job. (2) Colonists can fall back to the fixed wall ladder when a pit is too deep for the carryable one. Raiders can't. (3) Raiders who can't ladder or jump shovel a dirt causeway into the trench. Colonists have no fill-it-in rescue. Should the two sides match?
